Command.Statement: with MEMBER [Measures].[*CALCULATED_MEASURE_1] AS 'SetToStr( EXISTING [Product].[Product Category].Members )' SELECT {[Measures].[*CALCULATED_MEASURE_1]} ON COLUMNS from [ZFMSALES] WHERE {[Product].[Drink].[Alcoholic Beverages].[Beer and Wine].[Beer], [Product].[Drink].[Alcoholic Beverages].[Beer and Wine].[Wine], [Product].[Food].[Eggs].[Eggs] }
